topic: the yubiOS maintainer guide: the corpus explicates docs/MAINTAINER.md (maintainer responsibilities, review standards, merge and release discipline, governance)

subtopics.scope: docs/research planning branch, work-named implementation branches, no routine branch deletion, the summary/validation/known-inconsistencies PR bar, maintainer merge discipline.
PINNED.md, ADR.md, SPEC.md, MITIGATE.md, FUTURE.md, BLOCKERS.md, TODO.md, refs/ as the one-topic-one-file authority hierarchy and the historical-fragment override rule.
The 7-step cycle: read order, primary upstream sources, refs/ records, planning-cycle note naming, doc propagation, inconsistency flagging, PR plus issue outcome.
The four standing corrections: RestrictFileSystems vs v261 RestrictFileSystemAccess, PINNED.md live digests, ARM64 primary, TEST-only image isolation.

Retry only likely-transient failures, deterministic failures become fixes or blockers, old-sha reruns do not validate main, narrow path-scoped trigger edits, outcomes summarized in the motivating issue/PR.
Release provenance citations (branch, commit, workflow run, artifact/tag), digest bumps update PINNED.md with package-floor evidence, production/test classification before publication.
The five coverage sections: attestation (in-toto, Rekor, SLSA, Sigstore, bootupd, Keylime), trust chain, least privilege, continuous/adaptive detection, cryptographic identity.
Dated drift-check entries appended to the doc, additive classification, and the Jenny-merges discipline (agent PRs held, maintainer merges) verified across rounds 9-11.
